Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.body: The forecast is a read-only lens over your pipeline: weighted values per stage or period, sales indicators and the monthly revenue outlook, broken down by source. A forecast is not an accounting figure; only the actuals column in the comparison comes from posted revenue. When the data behind an indicator is too thin, it shows a dash rather than a fabricated zero.
